4.1.0.title: Ace is its own app now
4.1.0.text: Ace.exe opens straight to Ace, like the iPad app: the orb up top, the chat under it. No dashboard.

4.1.0.title: Click the orb for Settings
4.1.0.text: Pick Normal Ace or LFM3 Omni as the brain, plus updates, sounds and voice.

4.1.0.title: Hold the orb to talk
4.1.0.text: Or press Ctrl+Alt+Space, or say "Hey Ace".

4.1.0.title: Runs by itself
4.1.0.text: No .NET install needed. Just unzip and double-click Ace.exe.

4.1.0.title: 493 new facts
4.1.0.text: Shapes, art, geography, science, animals, sports, history, inventions and more.

4.1.0.title: Better memory
4.1.0.text: Tell me "my dog is named Biscuit" or "my favorite color is green" and ask me later.

4.1.0.title: Trivia fix
4.1.0.text: Answers like "J.K. Rowling", "T. rex" and "Mauna Kea" count now instead of confusing me.

4.1.0.title: What's new and beta updates
4.1.0.text: These notes show after an update. Turn on beta updates in Settings to get new stuff first.

4.1.0.title: Understands you better
4.1.0.text: Ignores filler like "kinda" and "or something", and "what is RAM" gets an answer instead of a PC check.

4.0.0.title: Ace V4
4.0.0.text: A smarter brain that thinks in steps and shows you how it got each answer.

4.0.0.title: 62 built-in scripts
4.0.0.text: Roblox Lua and C++ scripts like kill bricks and moving parts, and Ace can explain them line by line.

4.0.0.title: Trivia high scores
4.0.0.text: Ace keeps your best scores and streaks.

4.0.0.title: Auto-update
4.0.0.text: Ace updates itself from GitHub, keeps a backup and goes back to it if something breaks.
